_comment: Card enchantments (backlog #12, the engine half of #3). A data-driven modifier attached to ONE card via Card.enchanted_copy() -- the same generic-copy trick upgraded_copy() already uses, just carrying a named effect+value instead of bumping numbers. Combat (or later, the view) reads effect+value rather than special-casing an enchant id per card, the same shape relics.json already uses for team-wide mods. Only 'sure' has a /core consumer today (Combat.play_card); 'wide' is valid, tested data waiting on the card-face + timing-window UI work that #3 still owns -- deliberately not wired into the view here (needs a screen).

sure.name: Sure
sure.text: This card's timing always lands, even on a fumble.

wide.name: Wide
wide.text: A much wider timing window for this card.
